passage.text: This green curry is for four people.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri ɪz fər ˈfɔːr ˈpiːpəl.

passage.text: You need half a kilo of chicken, two cans of coconut milk and some green curry paste.
passage.reading: juː ˈniːd ˈhæf ə ˈkiːloʊ əv ˈtʃɪkən, ˈtuː ˈkænz əv ˌkoʊkənʌt ˈmɪlk ənd sʌm ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri ˌpeɪst.

passage.text: You need some fish sauce, a teaspoon of sugar and a little basil, too.
passage.reading: juː ˈniːd sʌm ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs, ə ˈtiːspuːn əv ˈʃʊɡər ənd ə ˈlɪtəl ˈbeɪzəl, ˈtuː.

passage.text: First, cook the curry paste in a pan with a little coconut milk.
passage.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ˈkʊk ðə ˈkɜːri ˌpeɪst ɪn ə ˈpæn wɪð ə ˈlɪtəl ˌkoʊkənʌt ˈmɪlk.

passage.text: Next, add the chicken and stir for five minutes.
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst, ˈæd ðə ˈtʃɪkən ənd ˈstɜːr fər ˈfaɪv ˈmɪnɪts.

passage.text: Then add the other can of coconut milk and boil it for ten minutes.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ˈæd ði ˈʌðər ˈkæn əv ˌkoʊkənʌt ˈmɪlk ənd ˈbɔɪl ɪt fər ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts.

passage.text: After that, add the fish sauce and the sugar.
passage.reading: ˈæftər ˈðæt, ˈæd ðə ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs ənd ðə ˈʃʊɡər.

passage.text: Finally, add the basil and serve the curry in a big bowl with rice.
passage.reading: ˈfaɪnəli, ˈæd ðə ˈbeɪzəl ənd ˈsɜːrv ðə ˈkɜːri ɪn ə ˈbɪɡ ˈboʊl wɪð ˈraɪs.

passage.text: Be careful: green curry can be very spicy!
passage.reading: bi ˈkɛrfəl: ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri kən bi ˈvɛri ˈspaɪsi!
